structure.part1Desc: Listen to descriptions and select the best statement describing the picture.
structure.part2Desc: Listen to a question and choose the appropriate response.
structure.part3Desc: Listen to conversations and answer questions (3 questions per dialogue).
structure.part4Desc: Listen to talks and answer questions (3 questions per talk).
structure.part5Desc: Choose the best word or phrase to complete the sentence.
structure.part6Desc: Fill in words, phrases, or sentences into blanks within short texts.
structure.part7Desc: Read single passages, double passages, and triple passages and answer questions.
structure.readingSectionMeta: Incomplete Sentences, Text Completion, Comprehension • 75 mins

detailPage.sideCalloutDesc: Part 3 and Part 4 share a single audio file for each conversation/talk. Each passage contains 3 consecutive questions grouped together.

createQuestionPage.guidePart1: Each question consists of 1 photograph and 4 statements (A, B, C, D). Examinees choose the statement that best describes the picture.
createQuestionPage.guidePart2: Each question consists of 1 question/statement with only 3 options (A, B, C). No option D.

createQuestionPage.guidePart4: Consists of short talks/messages by 1 speaker. Each shared audio answers 3 consecutive questions.

createQuestionPage.guidePart7: Consists of single, double, or triple reading passages. Shared across 2 to 5 reading questions.

rules.optPrefix: - Options formatted as A., B., C., D. or (A) (B) (C) (D).
rules.ansPrefix: - Correct answer: Answer: B or Key: B.
rules.passagePrefix: - Start with Passage: followed by Title: and Content: or Transcript:.
rules.passageLink: - Questions following this block will automatically link to the passage.
rules.imagePrefix: - Image URL: Image: https://... (or embedded in docx)
